description: ANSI Z87.1 certified chemical splash goggles must be worn at all times in the chemistry laboratory regardless of whether performing an experiment.
warning_speech: Safety alert! Safety goggles are mandatory at all times at the chemistry workbench. Put on your protective eye goggles immediately.

description: Immediate continuous flushing with water at the eye-wash station for a minimum of 15 minutes. Hold eyelids open. Alert the lab instructor immediately.
warning_speech: Emergency! Chemical splash to eyes requires immediate continuous flushing at the eyewash station for fifteen minutes. Keep eyelids wide open. Notifying instructor.

description: Flush skin immediately with copious cold running water for at least 15 minutes. Remove contaminated clothing immediately. Seek medical assistance.
warning_speech: Emergency! Immediately wash affected skin under continuous cold running water for fifteen minutes. Remove any contaminated clothing.

description: Operations producing toxic, irritating, or flammable fumes (concentrated HCl, HNO3, ammonia, bromine, organic solvents) must be conducted inside a certified fume hood with sash below marker.
warning_speech: Attention! Concentrated acids, ammonia, and organic solvents produce noxious vapors and must be handled inside the fume hood with the sash lowered.
lcd_message:
FUME HOOD REQUIRED
LOWER THE SASH

description: Never pour heavy metals (lead, mercury, chromium, silver), halogenated or non-halogenated organics down the municipal sink drain. Dispose of in dedicated labeled waste carboys.
warning_speech: Notice! Never dispose of chemical reagents or heavy metals down the laboratory sink. Deposit all titration and reaction waste into the designated waste container.
lcd_message:
NO SINK DISPOSAL!
USE WASTE CARBOY
triggers: can i pour this in drain

description: Hot glass looks identical to cold glass. Always use heat-resistant tongs or silicone grips when handling beakers and flasks from hot plates.
warning_speech: Reminder: Hot glass appears identical to cold glass. Always handle heated beakers with insulated crucible tongs or thermal gloves.
lcd_message:
HOT GLASS ALERT:
USE BEAKER TONGS
